notes.title: Crispy Patch
notes.content: A general patch to address some minor bugs and inconsistencies as well as correct a graphical issue affecting some users with a high resolution monitor. The resulting experience should be more crisp/sharp for all users!

notes.title: Valentine's Day Release
notes.content:
Thanks to the support of the Steam Greenlight Community, elaine is now available on the Steam Store! Enjoy the non-stop action of six uniquely challenging levels as you compete for a spot on the global leaderboards!

How far will you get?
